author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before's flame was a round blob with a V bite that read as Pac-Man. Now it is a Lucide-style flame (round r10 body, S-curved inner stroke rising to a pointed tip, lower-left notch bowl) under a sprinkler pipe hanging from the ceiling line, matching the reference's ceiling, stub and flame.
omissions: The pipe now joins the ceiling (the reference leaves a gap) to buy the flame height under 8-unit spacing.
